# spoke_project (Data Source)

Read the scope explicitly selected in provider configuration. Uses the provisional mock API and never provisions a scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spoke_project" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable ID of the explicitly selected scope.
- `name` (String) Observed display name.
- `organization_id` (String) Owning organization ID.
